result.title: Accounts and connection
result.acceptance: Through the real local v0.3 launchers, create the first owner in a fresh v0.3 store and sign in with a username and password. Refuse a v0.1 or v0.2 store with a clear message and leave it untouched. Restore authorized routes after refresh and browser reopen. Verify current-session and all-session sign-out with two independent sessions for one account and an unaffected second member. Demonstrate member reset, owner code and server-machine recovery, polished MUI forms and independent workspace regression QA against the PI plan. In Profile, rename to an available username, change password, edit an introduction and optional email, and add, replace or remove a picture. Demonstrate member self-deletion, last-owner protection, private Home isolation, the username staying reserved for 30 days, restoration before the deadline, then hard deletion on a separate expired fixture.
